style: Create one finished enemy sprite for the ADV Japanese dungeon RPG. The attached sheet is only a visual style reference. Paint exactly one new full-body creature matching the project’s hand-painted bestiary, crisp ink contours, warm upper-left light, tactile painted details and a strong silhouette that reads at 96 pixels. Three-quarter view toward the left or viewer, isolated and centered within a square with generous clear margins on all sides. Genuine transparent alpha around and between appendages. The frame contains only the individual creature and its attached anatomy or growths. Plain cutout with clean edges, rim highlights confined to its silhouette.

guard_1_elite.prompt: Underground waterworks guardian. A squat massive sapphire-blue gelatinous sluice beast with a thick overlapping back carapace shaped like three worn bronze sluice plates and one small amber glass valve-eye. Wide bracing liquid forepaws, river-polished indigo shadows and turquoise current lines. Compact arched body with a gap under its belly, an unmistakable old waterworks sentinel. The metal is set into the creature.

guard_3.prompt: Root-eating underground garden beast, a darting chestnut-brown root grub coiled into a hook. A rust-red seed-husk mantle, two large ivory pruning-mandibles at the front biting a fibrous root, tiny dark eyes, pale segmented underbelly and a forked digging tail. Entire creature in side three-quarter, poised on its little gripping legs.

guard_3_elite.prompt: Guardian of the root-eaten garden, a great low four-footed beast with a thick ivory taproot for its trunk, heavy curled burl shoulders and a split seed-pod maw lined with green poison fangs. A single mature rosehip and ferns growing from its weathered copper-brown wooden back. Sturdy sprawling silhouette, broad flat head, visible root-knuckle feet, forward-facing stance.

moss_crawler.prompt: The tiny Moss-Crown Imp from the story about a crown passed from creature to creature. Small wiry crawling forest imp with four long delicate webbed limbs and a lopsided removable circlet made of woven twigs with three bright moss knobs sitting askew on its head. Dark aubergine amphibian skin, curious narrowed golden eyes; crouches sideways close to the ground, long trailing tail. Readably an imp wearing its transferable moss circlet.

water_darter.prompt: A single tiny darting canal minnow. Delicate slim silver-blue body with an upward flick of a bright orange bifurcated tail, wide clear pale fins, one dark lateral stripe and one curious shiny eye, a strong diagonal swimming gesture. Full side profile with a slight turn, readable fine ink outlines.

water_predator.prompt: A waterway fangfish, deep-bodied predatory pike-perch, iron teal and dusky coral striped scales, raised spiny crimson dorsal sail, long projecting lower jaw with four prominent milk-white fangs. Tail curved in a tight hunting turn. Broad angular head and projecting lower teeth dominate a fierce compact full-body silhouette.

water_giant.prompt: The Great Water Gulper, a cavernous ancient catfish leviathan with huge semicircular open funnel-mouth, a pale circular inner throat, two long curved whiskers, tiny amber eyes, broad mottled deep navy head and muscular tapering tail curling behind. Full body in swimming pose toward viewer left; massive pectoral fins flare on either side. Emphasize the extraordinary mouth width.

salt_eater.prompt: Salt Eater of the abandoned mine, a pale stone-grey long-snouted squat burrowing animal with six stubby limbs and a long rough pink mineral-licking tongue touching a clump of angular rose-white halite crystals growing on its own raised forepaw. Faceted salt crystals coat its arched back like a low ridge, eyes dark and beady, chisel-like muzzle. Barrellike body seen in three-quarter. Emphasize salt crystals and mineral-feeding anatomy.

kagaribi_wax_slime.prompt: Candle-wax slime. Warm ivory beeswax, a low folded wax pool creeping forward with one tall leaning candle stub fused into its back, a tiny warm flame at its curled wick. Its face peeks from a hanging sheet of wax folded over a small hollow at the very front. Layered long drips and wax rings, terracotta shadows, waxy matte edges. Asymmetrical elongated crawling silhouette with one high back candle distinctly different from the gold upright wick slime in the reference.

kagaribi_oil_wax.prompt: Oil-store wax slime. A bottom-heavy amber lantern-shaped monster, squat faceted translucent beeswax walls, dark burnt umber oil visibly sloshing inside through a clear band, two low black wick-like antennae, one little flame visible low inside its belly. The top collapses into a cupped wax lip; wide skirt forms a few sturdy lobes. Small copper eyes set into the outer body. The entire figure reads as one living oily wax mass, dark mahogany and amber.

waterway_young_eel.prompt: Juvenile electric eel of the old waterway. Extremely slim translucent pale sea-green glass eel curled into a loose C, visibly delicate little pectoral fins, a single warm yellow luminous electric organ line through its tiny body, large dark curious eye and a rounded blunt little snout. Entire flexible animal swimming; inside the arc remains transparent. Tiny and youthful, bright and soft.

waterway_low_eel.prompt: Mature low-tier electric eel in the waterway. A stocky ink-blue eel coiling in one broad angular S as it raises its blunt head toward the left. Pronounced saffron paired electrocyte patches down its flanks, small blue-white arcs hugging just the side of its body, flattened copper-orange tail fin. Full body, heavy jaw and purposeful gaze, more muscular and darker than a juvenile.

waterway_low_clam.prompt: Mud-filter clam monster. A single broad fan-shaped double-valve shell hinged open in three-quarter view, brown umber radial ribs with dark olive silt, rust-red gills arranged as soft fluted filtering fans inside and a pair of short cream siphon tubes with distinctly open tips. A thin band of turquoise nacre along the shell lip. Emphasize clam anatomy, a low stable triangular silhouette, closed outline in the back.
